component.name: alibaba-eventbridge
component.title: Alibaba EventBridge
component.description: Publish events to Alibaba Cloud EventBridge.
component.label: cloud,messaging

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventType.label: producer

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSpec.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSpec.description: Validate CloudEvents 1.0 specification constraints on map fields

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeAllowedEventSourc.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeAllowedEventSourc.description: Allowed event sources and source-scoped event types per event bus (DSL string, JSON, Map, or List)

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSourceCacheT.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSourceCacheT.description: TTL in milliseconds for cached bus event sources and types

allowedEventSources.label: producer
allowedEventSources.description: Allowed event sources and source-scoped event types per event bus. Supports multi-bus DSL (bussrc - type1,type2), single-bus shorthand (src - type1,type2), JSON string, or Map/List objects.

endpoint.description: EventBridge endpoint URL. Carries higher precedence than region based client initialization

validateEventSource.label: producer
validateEventSource.description: When true, verifies that the target event bus exists in Alibaba Cloud EventBridge using listEventBuses before publishing. Also validates the CloudEvent source URI against the allowedEventSources whitelist when that option is set.

validateEventSpec.label: producer
validateEventSpec.description: Validate CloudEvents 1.0 specification constraints on map fields

validateEventType.label: producer
validateEventType.description: When true, verifies that the CloudEvent event type is valid for the event source on the target event bus against Alibaba Cloud rule filter patterns before publishing.

eventSourceCacheTtl.label: producer,advanced
eventSourceCacheTtl.description: TTL in milliseconds for caching event bus existence lookups per bus name. Applies only when validateEventSource is true.
